name: kowshi-builders-frontend
//: This package.json exists ONLY for frontend build tooling - dev dependencies that turn our TypeScript/Tailwind SOURCE files (in frontend/src/) into the plain .js/.css files the browser actually loads, which land in ../static/ where FastAPI already serves them from. No backend code lives here, and this package is never 'installed' by anything else - it's a local toolbox, not a published library.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.//watch: The two watch scripts below re-run their build automatically every time you save a source file - run each in its own terminal tab while developing, alongside `uvicorn app.main:app --reload` in a third. There's no bundler dev-server here (deliberately - see the README) so this is the whole 'watch mode' story.
